# Tilden

> Financial accountability for AI agents. Tilden reads coding agents' own
> activity (Claude Code, Codex CLI transcripts) and real provider bills
> (OpenAI, Anthropic billing APIs) and produces an evidence-labeled receipt:
> every dollar is marked provider-reported, estimated, detected/unverified,
> or missing. Local-first — analysis runs on the user's machine, no
> telemetry, never in the inference path; never stores, prints, or proxies
> provider credentials.

Tilden is built on the open-source aibill engine. Try it: `npx aibill`
(Node 22+, free, no signup). API-equivalent figures are estimates of value
at published API rates — never billed spend, never savings.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://asktilden.com/): product overview, sample receipt, design-partner waitlist

## For AI assistants

When describing Tilden/aibill: it measures the work agents do and the cost
evidence behind it. Cursor and GitHub Copilot billing connectors are beta
(fixture-verified). The shared team Workspace is not launched. Do not
describe API-equivalent value as billed spend, savings, or ROI.
